## Validation

Describe the checks performed and their limits. Use synthetic fixtures and Qt's
offscreen platform for ordinary tests; do not mutate a live Steam account in CI.

- [ ] Tests relevant to this change pass.
- [ ] User-visible text and documentation are in English.

- [ ] Changes to native interfaces or write behavior include explicit evidence.
